question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    (
        -- Age calculation: exactly 25 years old on 2026-09-25
        -- This means the 25th anniversary of birth_date is on or before 2026-09-25
        -- and the 26th anniversary is after 2026-09-25
        strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) <= '09-25' 
        AND strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) > '09-25' - 1
    ) OR (
        -- Handle the case where birth month-day is after Sept 25
        strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) > '09-25'
        AND strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) <= '12-31'
        AND (2026 - CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - 1) = 25
    ) OR (
        -- Handle the case where birth month-day is before or on Sept 25
        strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) <= '09-25'
        AND (2026 - CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) = 25
    );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST((SUBSTR('2026-09-24', 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 25
  AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) <= SUBSTR('2026-09-24', 6, 2) || SUBSTR('2026-09-24', 9, 2)
  AND (SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > SUBSTR('2026-09-24', 6, 2) || SUBSTR('2026-09-24', 9, 2)
       OR (SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) || SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) = SUBSTR('2026-09-24', 6, 2) || SUBSTR('2026-09-24', 9, 2)
           AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 12, 2) <= SUBSTR('2026-09-24', 12, 2)));

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?

WHERE (

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-12-01 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    -- Exactly 25 years old on 2026-12-01 means:
    -- Born on 2001-12-01 (25th anniversary is 2026-12-01)
    -- Or born on 2001-12-01 exactly
    -- Using completed age logic: age = 25 when the 25th birthday is on or before 2026-12-01
    -- and the 26th birthday is after 2026-12-01
    -- This means birth_date must be between 2001-12-02 and 2002-12-01 (inclusive of 2001-12-02, exclusive of 2002-12-01)
    -- Actually: born on B, age on D is N when N-th anniversary of B <= D < (N+1)-th anniversary
    -- So for N=25 and D=2026-12-01:
    -- 25th anniversary of B <= 2026-12-01 < 26th anniversary of B
    -- This means B must be in [2001-12-02, 2002-12-01)
    -- But wait: if born on 2001-12-01, then 25th anniversary is 2026-12-01 (which is <= D)
    -- and 26th anniversary is 2027-12-01 (which is > D), so age is 25
    -- If born on 2001-12-02, then 25th anniversary is 2026-12-02 (which is > D), so age is 24
    -- So actually: born on 2001-12-01 exactly gives age 25 on 2026-12-01
    -- Let's verify: born 2001-12-01, on 2026-12-01, it's exactly the 25th birthday, so age is 25
    -- Born 2001-12-02, on 2026-12-01, the 25th birthday hasn't occurred yet, so age is 24
    -- So the condition is: birth_date = '2001-12-01'
    c.birth_date = '2001-12-01'
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
      CAST((STRFTIME('%Y', '2026-09-25') - STRFTIME('%Y', c.birth_date)) AS INTEGER) = 25
      AND (
          STRFTIME('%m-%d', c.birth_date) <= STRFTIME('%m-%d', '2026-09-25')
          OR STRFTIME('%m-%d', c.birth_date) = '02-29'
      )
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of products a, b and c only, for orders placed from 2026-01-01 00:00:00 to 2026-07-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?

  AND o.date >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00'

  AND (

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-05-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00 by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-05-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', o.date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) = 25
    AND (
      CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) > CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      OR (
        CAST(strftime('%m', o.date) AS INTEGER) = CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
        AND CAST(strftime('%d', o.date) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(strftime('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      )
    )
  );

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of product d only, for orders placed from 2026-09-01 00:00:00 to 2026-10-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.product_id = 'd'
  AND o.date >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND (
      CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 25
      AND (
          CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) < 9
          OR (CAST(strftime('%m', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) = 9 AND CAST(strftime('%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) <= 25)
      )
  );
